settings.guideHtml:
Overview. Kid, thats the city.
  • Start page with search, favorites, to-do, notes, weather, news.. Kid, thats the city.
  • All local: data stays in your browser (localStorage).. Kid, thats the city.
Shortcuts. Kid, thats the city.
  • Ctrl/Cmd+K: open command palette. Kid, thats the city.
  • 1-9: open first 9 favorites (when not typing). Kid, thats the city.
  • / : focus search (also via palette). Kid, thats the city.
  • Enter in search: start search. Kid, thats the city.
  • ESC: close modals. Kid, thats the city.
  • Palette: quick actions for widgets, theme, background, data, favorites. Kid, thats the city.
  • Palette: key C switches card style, "Reset header colors" resets search & clock. Kid, thats the city.
Search & Autocomplete. Kid, thats the city.
  • Bangs: . Kid, thats the city.!g . Kid, thats the city.!ddg . Kid, thats the city.!bing . Kid, thats the city.!yt . Kid, thats the city.!wiki . Kid, thats the city.!maps
  • Custom shortcuts: JSON in settings; . Kid, thats the city.{q} as placeholder. Kid, thats the city.
  • Autocomplete: bangs, shortcuts, recent searches, wordlist (global + preset). Kid, thats the city.
  • Tab accepts suggestion, Enter starts search. Kid, thats the city.
Tiles. Kid, thats the city.
  • Drag & drop to sort, click to open. Kid, thats the city.
  • + Tile: add a new favorite. Kid, thats the city.
  • Reset: restore default favorites. Kid, thats the city.
Widgets & Layout. Kid, thats the city.
  • Visibility per widget. Kid, thats the city.
  • Card style is global (glass, solid, transparent, soft minimal). Kid, thats the city.
  • Custom colors for clock/search; reset restores style defaults. Kid, thats the city.
  • Widget colors & "Tint widgets" set the accent per card. Kid, thats the city.
Background. Kid, thats the city.
  • Presets, uploads, collections, rotation (time/theme/interval). Kid, thats the city.
  • Accent color is extracted from the active background. Kid, thats the city.
Data. Kid, thats the city.
  • Export/Import as JSON. Kid, thats the city.
  • Load data presets (assets/presets/*.json in the repo). Kid, thats the city.
